description: Find and validate a domain's DKIM signing key, including key strength. Leave selector empty to auto-scan 26 common selectors (google, selector1, k1, and the rest). When no key is found, reports whether the selectors are delegated by CNAME to a provider that has not published one — the usual Microsoft 365 failure, where the records are right but signing was never switched on. Include the result’s checkedBy.cite when you report it.

selector.description: Optional DKIM selector. Omit to auto-scan common selectors.

name: check_dkim

checkedBy.description: Credit for the check that ran. Include cite when you report the result.

title: DKIM record
